description: Check whether a down-migration actually reverses its up-migration. Matches each operation against its inverse on the same table and column, and reports what would be left in place after a rollback. Reports an up-migration that discards data, which no down-migration can restore without a backup, and a down-migration that drops or truncates something the up-migration never created, which would destroy unrelated data during a rollback. Pay 240000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

down.description: The down-migration statements intended to reverse them. SQL text, at most 262144 bytes and 2000 statements. CREATE TABLE, ALTER TABLE, CREATE and DROP INDEX, DROP TABLE, TRUNCATE, GRANT and REVOKE are read; anything else is listed in not_examined rather than guessed at. No database is contacted and no rows are read, so an arbitrary schema can be audited with no credential and no grant.
down.example:
ALTER TABLE accounts DROP COLUMN locale;
TRUNCATE TABLE audit_log;

up.description: The up-migration statements. SQL text, at most 262144 bytes and 2000 statements. CREATE TABLE, ALTER TABLE, CREATE and DROP INDEX, DROP TABLE, TRUNCATE, GRANT and REVOKE are read; anything else is listed in not_examined rather than guessed at. No database is contacted and no rows are read, so an arbitrary schema can be audited with no credential and no grant.

name: sql_migration_reversibility_audit

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

reversible.description: True only when every up operation had a matching inverse, nothing destructive was found and everything was read.

title: SQL Migration Reversibility Audit
